top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is a mature, independently reproduced achievement: the magic-wavelength lattice removes the trap-induced shift while many atoms are interrogated at once, bringing frequency measurement to the 10^-18 level. Credit maps cleanly onto Katori (the magic-wavelength idea) and Ye (the realisation at the highest accuracy and stability), and the citation scope is tight and defensible, so awarding it is preferable to no award.
